dataSafety.title: Data safety

dataSafety.revivalNote: Restoring an old backup brings deleted data back: the backup contains transactions that had not been deleted at the time, so they reappear in the ledger and trash after restore. Permanent deletion only affects the current database and cannot be recovered from outside a backup.

tagEdit.title: Edit tags
tagEdit.inputPlaceholder: Type a tag, then press Enter or click Add
tagEdit.hint: Tags are annotations: they update in place, create no reversal, and stay editable.
tagEdit.offlineDisabled: Tag editing requires a connection for now; offline editing is coming in a later release
tagEdit.forbidden: Your account cannot edit the tags on this entry
tagEdit.conflictTitle: Tags were updated by someone else
tagEdit.conflictHint: Tags were updated by someone else; check them and try again
tagEdit.errInvalid: Invalid tags: at most 32 tags, 64 characters each, no control characters
tagEdit.errGeneric: Could not save tags; please try again
tagEdit.detailHint: Tags are annotations: they update in place, create no reversal, and stay editable.
tagEdit.historyLegacyHint: Tag edits made before the upgrade were not recorded; only later edits appear below.
tagEdit.historyLoadFailed: Could not load edit history; please retry
tagEdit.offlineSaved: Tags saved offline; they'll merge when you're back online
tagEdit.mergeToastBody: Offline tag changes merged with the cloud; no reversal was created
tagEdit.mergeNoticeLine: Recent merge: {n} conflicts resolved by most recent edit (non-blocking)
tagEdit.mergeRetryLater: Tag merge pending; it'll retry on next sync
tagEdit.mergeDropped: This entry is no longer editable; offline tag changes were not applied
syncError.account_closed.reason: The account this change refers to is closed and cannot sync.
syncError.account_closed.action: Re-record it with an open account, or discard this item after confirming.
syncError.account_balance_not_zero.reaso: The account to close still has a non-zero balance; sync was rejected.
syncError.account_balance_not_zero.actio: Transfer the remaining balance out, then resubmit this change.
syncError.opening_via_api_only.reason: Opening balances cannot be set through offline sync.
syncError.opening_via_api_only.action: Set the opening balance online from account management instead.
syncError.idempotency_key_deleted.reason: The transaction for this request was deleted and cannot be retried.
syncError.idempotency_key_deleted.action: Record it again, or discard this item after confirming.
syncError.idempotency_payload_mismatch.r: The same request ID maps to different content; the server rejected the merge.
syncError.idempotency_payload_mismatch.a: Resubmit this change, or discard this item after confirming.
syncError.validation.reason: Validation failed; the server rejected this change.
syncError.validation.action: Fix the data using the raw message below, then retry.
syncError.account_not_found.reason: The account referenced by this change does not exist on the server.
syncError.account_not_found.action: Refresh and retry; if it still fails, check whether the account was deleted.
syncError.network_error.reason: The network connection failed; this sync did not complete.
syncError.network_error.action: Check your connection and retry. Local data is safe on this device.
syncError.unauthorized.reason: Your session has expired and cannot sync.
syncError.unauthorized.action: Please sign in again and retry.
syncError.forbidden.reason: Your account does not have permission for this sync.
syncError.forbidden.action: Ask the ledger owner to check permissions, then retry.
syncError.invalid_push_results.reason: The server returned incomplete push results; the whole batch was kept for retry.
syncError.invalid_push_results.action: Retry later; if it persists, export the error details and report it.
syncError.http_error.action: Retry later; local changes are not lost.
syncP1.deadEmpty: No dead letters. Only permanent failures (e.g. posting to a closed account) land here.
syncP1.retryScheduled: Waiting for the next automatic retry
syncP1.batchScope: Only affects failed items listed below; already uploaded items are untouched
syncP1.discardConfirmBody: This cannot be undone. Export a backup first; already uploaded data is untouched.
syncP1.copyFailed: Copy failed; please select the text manually
syncP1.summary: This sync · {success} succeeded · {retry} retrying · {dead} need action
